findings.issue: Four `fin_cases` bullets (lines 110-115 and 136-139) each spell out a `simp only [Fin.zero_eta, ...]` / `simp only [Fin.mk_one, ...]` set tied to the exact index representation `fin_cases` produces, with near-identical follow-up tactics. summary: Proofs are short and use robust automation, but the central fact `g * sin θ_W = g' * cos θ_W` is re-derived inline in two places and reached via `.mpr rfl` in a third instead of being stated once; one proof also pairs `field_simp at ht ⊢` with `linear_combination ht`, which is tied to `field_simp`'s normal form.
